law: Each upgrade gross value xi_g is independently Uniform[0.1,2.5]; each of the two base projects in a bundle has original gross return 0.25.
cost_map: Use each sealed original signed affine map: base-item costs -0.25 and upgrade cost -xi_g. Maximize original gross profit; solver minimizes its negative. No base return or other constant is subtracted.
rng_seed_derivation: seed128 = little-endian integer of first 16 bytes of SHA256(UTF8(rng_namespace + '|G=' + decimal G + '|physical_seed=' + decimal seed))
shared_bank_rule: For each physical seed, G32 n36 and n69 use exactly the same 120 original objectives and references; their distinct training/model bindings remain separately recorded.
global_gate: A required expected freeze SHA256 and confirmation_runner.validate_global_freeze(freeze_path, semantic=True) must verify every one of the 12 cases / 24 method roles / 12 ND checkpoints, all training/data/source bindings, this protocol and the generator source before any objective RNG is created or any confirmation bank is accessed.
original_model: All frozen original CSR matrix rows, row bounds, binary variable bounds and integrality are retained; no optimizer equalities are added to the Full reference IP.
reference_certificates: For every distinct objective: a cold original single-thread HiGHS binary-IP optimality certificate and an independent maximum-weight independent-set bitmask memo recursion must agree. Negative upgrade premiums are excluded from MWIS candidates. No full optimizer-map enumeration is required.

independent_reference_limits.on_exhaustion: Abort the partial bank without replacing costs, changing the law, or publishing an uncertified reference.

reference_timing: New cold Full wall/process-CPU intervals include model construction, original-IP solve and validation. Independent MWIS timing is separate. This is newly recorded reference generation, not the unknown historical training-label generation time.
failed_reference_rule: Any uncertified or mismatching reference aborts publication of that bank. Retain partial artifacts for review; do not replace costs, change solver settings, overwrite a bank, or select a favorable subset.
